answer: Each identity posts a 50 POA bond into a vault; it decays 5 POA per epoch unless attestations renew it. When a gale of fake signups hits, the farmer behind 1,000 fakes locks 50,000 POA and must feed 5,000 POA per epoch, while an honest agent pays once and renews one bond with real work. Buying an aged identity does not help: decay continues under any owner. Like an opal in the sun, an idle identity fades; bulk forgery only multiplies the bill.
